prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: coordinated Sunlit Garden kitchen concept refinement.
Input image: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing small enclosed kitchen concept.
Primary request: Refine materials, practical styling and joinery while preserving the exact same camera, room dimensions, architecture, windows, clear glass kitchen enclosure, gas hob/hood, sink, floor-standing refrigerator, all existing cabinet footprint and usable aisle. Change ONLY the tall wall cabinets above the extractor from full pale honey oak doors to matte WARM IVORY/WHITE flat doors, with exact current division lines, dimensions and extractor underside. This reduces uniform pale wood and connects this kitchen to the dining room's white coffee cabinet. Keep every lower cupboard in natural pale honey oak, fine grain and aligned edge gaps. Keep all worktops pale warm-white stone and all backsplash square tiles warm white with light warm grey grout.
Small styling refinements: make the small existing condiment tray between sink and hob matte deep warm chestnut brown, matching a dark cherry dining table finish around #6b4435, as one tiny repeat. Use restrained cream/sage ceramic utensils jar. Keep utensil handles contained and a clear stretch of prep counter. Keep the existing off-white pot and black pan on the gas hob, plausible burner/hood alignment. On the right side keep rice cooker and a small wooden cutting board with sparse herbs but move any foliage so it does not crowd rice cooker lid/steam path; the plant can be omitted rather than filling that spot. Keep the sink surroundings uncluttered, fine ivory/sage striped tea towel draped over cabinet edge clear of cooking flame. No more appliances or ornaments.
Critical physical details: refrigerator remains standing directly on FLOOR in its exact current space, never on top of or intersecting a worktop; preserve its usable front opening space. Keep already continuous short side preparation cabinet/counter where it exists, and do not invent a counter passing through the refrigerator. Preserve exact original window positions and no added windows. Wall/stone joints clean, lower drawers align, proper hob controls and credible sink/faucet geometry.
Light/material: same fresh bright natural daylight with warm-neutral whites, not yellow tint, gentle local extractor task light. Photoreal natural oak, matte paint, stone and brushed silver appliance surfaces. This room remains airy and practical; deep wood is a small tray only, never widespread dark cabinetry.
Deliver one 1536x1024 landscape photograph, no person, labels, watermark, collage or text.
